scope: Prediction-blind provenance review for the two frozen Track-B v2 external cohorts. This review does not establish absolute source independence; unresolved uncertainty is retained and therefore cannot raise either cohort above EXT-S under the current safe historical-comparison route.

review_basis: GVLiD is a separately published 2026 Mendeley Data dataset with its own named contributor group and a documented 2023 vineyard acquisition campaign in Maharashtra, India.
No documented direct contributor/source relationship to the frozen CropCop historical dataset provenance was identified in the pre-results repository review.
Absence of a documented relationship is not treated as proof of full independence; residual uncertainty is intentionally retained.
Irish Potato Version 01 is a separately archived Zenodo field-image dataset with its own acquisition record and class archives.
No documented direct contributor/source relationship to the frozen CropCop historical dataset provenance was identified in the pre-results repository review.
Absence of a documented relationship is not treated as proof of full independence; residual uncertainty is intentionally retained.
